Unknown conserved magnetic mean: a physical coupled shear pulse and paid affine-bias transfer
11 November 2026 Brisbane

1. The invariant and the actual changed equations.

On the unit torus the induction equation, tested against constants, gives integral B(t)=integral B0 when h_B has zero mean. Write this UNKNOWN conserved vector as H and b=B-H. Then
 u_t=nu Delta u-P[(u.grad)u-(b.grad)b]+(H.grad)b+f+h_u,
 b_t=rho Delta b-(u.grad)b+(b.grad)u+(H.grad)u+h_B.
Both u,b have zero mean if u0 does. The two H-dependent terms cancel in the TOTAL L2 energy pairing:
 <(H.grad)b,u>+<(H.grad)u,b>=0.
They are nevertheless real first-order couplings. Setting H=0 and invoking the zero-flux theorem would discard them. Different Galilean shifts cannot simultaneously remove the opposite background drifts in the two Elsasser fields while retaining one unknown-H-independent applied force.

The natural common endpoint is (V,H), not (V,0), with H unmeasured and not a compiler input. This retains the invariant while erasing every nonconstant magnetic component. It is not arbitrary magnetic target programming; if B0=h_B=0 then B stays zero under every mechanical force.

2. An EXACT physical single-shear sector with nonzero mean.

Let F=e_i s(x_j), i!=j, s=sin(kappa x_j) or cos(kappa x_j), kappa=2pi, c=s'. Take initial u=0,B=H with |H|<=M. The ansatz
 u(t)=x(t)F,
 B(t)=H+[z(t)/kappa]c(x_j)e_i
is invariant for the FULL mechanically forced MHD equations with force g(t)F and zero disturbances. No chosen magnetic source or prescribed extra velocity is used.

Indeed u.grad u=u.grad B=0,
 (B.grad)B=-kappa H_j z F,
 (B.grad)u=H_j x c e_i.
The Lorentz expression is solenoidal, so the Leray projection does not change it. The two amplitudes satisfy
 U'=A U+g e1, U=(x,z),
 A=[[-nu kappa^2,-kappa H_j],[kappa H_j,-rho kappa^2]].  (1)
The fluctuation-pair L2 norm is |U|/sqrt2. The off-diagonal Alfvén coupling is skew, and
 A+A^T=-2 diag(nu kappa^2,rho kappa^2).
Thus ||exp(tA)||_(2->2)<=1 for t>=0, uniformly over every H and positive diffusivity. With nu,rho<=1, the rational bound
 Lambda=100+14M
dominates ||A||. The matrix is an analysis object, not a quantity supplied to or evaluated by the output compiler.

3. The two-moment force extends to this actual coupled sector.

Use r(z)=z^2(1-z)^2(14z^2-14z+3), with r=r'=0 at endpoints,
 integral r=integral z r=0, integral r^2=3/10010, ||r||infinity<1.
